authority: experiment-owner direction on 2026-09-18 to run the OpenCode control at r3

preconditions_verified_before_spend: all three agent runtimes hash-verified against their pins

cause.finding: The OpenAI account reached its usage limit mid-run. This is provider budget exhaustion, not an apparatus defect and not a credential problem.
cause.provider_error: AI_APICallError: The usage limit has been reached
cause.where: Fastify task-06, on its first provider turn
cause.what_followed: OpenCode retried the stream with growing backoff -- 00:02, 00:11, 00:28, 01:02 -- each attempt failing immediately with the same error, until the 7200s per-task timeout killed the task at 01:58:49Z. The lane runner then exited nonzero before publication.
cause.not_the_2026_09_16_failure: The expired-credential stall is separately receipted and is resolved. Zero occurrences of 'Token refresh failed', '401 Unauthorized' or 'disposing instance' appear in this lane's OpenCode log; the twelve ERROR lines are all the usage-limit stream error.

disclosed_spend.scope: tasks 01-05 only; task-06 produced no provider turn and its event file is zero bytes
disclosed_spend.measurement_method: scripts/extract_opencode_usage.py per task, summed, then scripts/token_metrics.weighted_token_cost over the summed telemetry
disclosed_spend.note: This is real consumed budget with no usable result. It is NOT a zero-spend receipt. No session record was created, no comparison was published, and nothing merged.

replicate_slot_disposition.reasoning: The lane never reached publication, so no session record occupies the slot. The run is disclosed here rather than retained as a replicate, because it produced no complete workflow measurement: task-06 never executed. This is not a retained replicate dropped for the number it produced -- there is no number, the sixth task never ran.
replicate_slot_disposition.registry_unchanged: 111 sessions before and after; working tree clean.

beets_r3.reason: The matrix raised while handling the Fastify lane's failure inside execute_lane_jobs, so the Beets lane was never cloned.

secondary_behaviour_observed_and_correct.symptom: The matrix's final error was 'unsafe rejected evidence shape for opencode-fastify-20260918-p-4c934a33cbd1-r3; source checkout retained', which reads like a defect and is not one.
secondary_behaviour_observed_and_correct.explanation: preserve_rejected_lane_artifacts copies a rejected session directory only when it matches the safe atomic-copy contract: non-empty, at most 32 entries, every entry a plain non-symlink file, under 128MB. That shape is what a lane produces after compaction. This lane died mid-task, so its session directory still held codex-homes/, project/, controller-scratch/ and model-output/ directories.
secondary_behaviour_observed_and_correct.consequence: Preservation refused and the whole lane checkout was retained instead, which is the safer outcome: nothing was discarded. The retained checkout is the only record of the spend above and should not be deleted until this receipt is accepted.

operational_consequence.blocker: Provider budget, not apparatus. Any further OpenCode or Codex lane draws on the same OpenAI subscription and will fail the same way until the quota resets.
operational_consequence.do_not: Do not relaunch r3 before the quota resets; a relaunch would spend whatever remains and abort again, adding a second disclosure with no measurement.
operational_consequence.already_recorded_as_a_study_constraint: The roadmap already records provider budget as a scheduling constraint rather than only a cost, after the Anthropic five-hour session limit cut LeanCTX's second replicate and the Codex account's usage limit left CodeScope and RepoWise unmeasured. This is the third instance and the first to abort a control.
operational_consequence.what_r3_was_for: At one replicate per lane the OpenCode control has no observed spread, so the Beets reading -- 564,769.0, effectively on the floor of the Codex Beets pool -- cannot be distinguished from a single favourable draw. That question remains open.
